lead: H. D. Kumaraswamy is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 16 December 1959 in Haradanahalli.
As of 2026, he is 66 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Karnataka and Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
This profile collects the H. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: H. D. Kumaraswamy — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: H. D. Kumaraswamy was born on 16 December 1959 in Haradanahalli, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, H. D. Deve Gowda. He is a sibling of H. D. Revanna.

sections.heading: H. D. Kumaraswamy — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and film producer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Karnataka (2006–2007), Member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (2023–2024), Chief Minister of Karnataka (2018–2019), Member of the 11th Lok Sabha and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Janata Dal (Secular).

sections.heading: H. D. Kumaraswamy — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Anitha Kumaraswamy and Radhika Kumaraswamy.
He is a parent to Nikhil Kumarswamy.
He is associated with Bengaluru as a place of residence.
